question: Four entries of the awesome-tunneling list still have no egress record: ngrok 1.0 (github.com/inconshreveable/ngrok, open source section), Tailcat (tailscale.com/tailcat), Ngrok-operator (github.com/zufardhiyaulhaq/ngrok-operator) and Pomerium (pomerium.com). Which unit takes them?
why: A name match of all 156 linked entries against the 375 egress records found these four with no record and no alias; they lie outside entries 47 to 55 of the open source section, so this unit proposes nothing for them. ngrok 1.0 is archived software, Ngrok-operator is a Kubernetes operator for the commercial ngrok service, Tailcat and Pomerium need a first-party read to decide whether they are tunnels, overlays or neither.
